acceptance_criteria: `pub struct MassProperties { pub volume: f64, pub area: f64, pub mass: f64, pub center: Point3, pub inertia: [[f64; 3]; 3], pub principal: [f64; 3] }` (derive `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq`) and `fn mass_properties(&self, s: &Self::Shape, density: f64) -> Result<MassProperties, KernelError>`, documented with the conventions above. `principal` holds the eigenvalues of `inertia`, ascending. `s` is unchanged.
A density that is not finite or is ≤ 0 is `InvalidInput`, checked by a plain function before the backend. A shape with no solid (`body_count` 0) is `InvalidInput`.

`principal_moments(&[[f64; 3]; 3]) -> [f64; 3]`, a plain function using the cyclic Jacobi eigenvalue method for symmetric matrices (Golub & Van Loan, *Matrix Computations*, §8.5, cited in its doc comment). Unit tests without OCCT (1e-9 relative): a diagonal matrix diag(3, 1, 2) gives [1, 2, 3]; [[410.6̅, −400, 0], [−400, 410.6̅, 0], [0, 0, 810.6̅]] (exactly 1232/3, −400, 2432/3) gives [32/3, 2432/3, 2432/3].

With `--features occt` (1e-9 relative on volume, area, mass and the diagonal; 1e-9 absolute on center coordinates; off-diagonal entries within 1e-9 × the largest diagonal entry): cases 1–5 (box, density scaling, cylinder, two bodies, invalid inputs).
Every `unsafe` block added in `swx-kernel::ffi` is documented; the shim function is `noexcept` and catches all C++ exceptions (ADR 2026-10-13).
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and CI's `swx-kernel (occt)` job passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
